The patient continued treatment with prednisolone and periodic sessions of treatment with IV immunoglobulins. She improved further (video, segment 2), but there were 4 more mild clinical recurrences (video, segment 3) associated with an infection, mild head trauma, reduction of steroid, or increase in the interval between immunoglobulins; each improved quickly after treatment adjustment.
